tx.reason: uncertain or failed terminal boundary; no query injected

final_failure.reason: Shared TX result/terminal boundary missing or ambiguous
final_failure.RX_body_stats_scope: Retained, independently validated RX-only native body; coupled TX exposure remains FAILED.

limitations: One shared TX exposure produces two receiver observations; it is not two independent RF trials.
Requested baud and software store/call completions are not validated RF symbols or data throughput.
Frequencies/intervals are derived from nominal RX clocks; no independent calibration, frame decode, BER, analog/audio or one-way latency claim.
Envelope threshold qualification is an explicit per-snapshot quantile/MAD/FFT heuristic; missing qualification is not absence of RF.
First/last censored edge widths are excluded; insufficient expected cycles cannot establish steady source periodicity.
Paced skipped source slots break regular alternation. late_cycles is pending-deadline backlog before skipping, not output-symbol jitter.
Source origin and receiver mismatch causes have not been independently isolated; no board-brand or physical radio ceiling conclusion.
